name: aroflo-v2-mcp
description: Token-lean, read-only-by-default MCP server for the AroFlo API v2

scripts.spec:update: node scripts/spec-extract.mjs && node scripts/build-catalog.mjs && node scripts/spec-diff.mjs
scripts.spec:used: npm run build --silent && node -e "import('./dist/defaults.js').then(m => process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({ ops: m.usedOps() }, null, 1) + '\n'))" > spec/used.json
